name: hr
description: Starter policy for HR and recruiting agents. Inspired by the DPDP Act 2023 (purpose limitation, data minimisation) and the principle that automated decisions about people need a human. Reading the directory is fine; sensitive fields (salary, bank, Aadhaar, PAN, health) and every change need a human; deleting records and sending employee data outside the company are blocked; hiring and firing decisions are always made by a person. A technical starting point, NOT legal advice. Replace 'acme\.com' with your company's email domain.
tools: hr.search_employees(query, limit), hr.read_employee(employee_id, fields), hr.update_employee(employee_id, field, value), hr.delete_employee(employee_id), hr.decide_candidate(candidate_id, decision), hr.terminate(employee_id), payroll.run(month), email.send(to, subject, body, attachment), files.read(path)

rules.reason: employee personal data may not leave the company (DPDP, taint)
Aadhaar or PAN number sent outside the company
agents may not delete employee records
decisions about people are made by a person, not an agent
changing employee records needs a human
sensitive personal data needs a human (DPDP data minimisation)
bulk exports of employee data need a human
reading names, roles and teams is fine (max 200 lookups an hour)
reading files is fine; what leaves is checked
